newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia leading shares down, seen down.
newsitem.headline: Russia leading shares down, seen down.

text.p: Leading Russian shares eased on Thursday and some Western investors were seen selling, traders said, predicting the downtrend would continue at least into Friday morning.
"No traders are going to take an active position on blue chips since clients do not like current levels," said Renaissance Capital trader Victor Pitaleff.
The Russian Trading System index of 23 shares closed up slightly at 299.87 after Tuesday's 298.52 close on low total market volume of $20.3 million.
The NAUFOR brokers association, which calculates the index said, Wednesday's 375.06 was unrepresentative of underlying share prices.

Bellwether electric utility UES EESR.RTS traded at $0.1862 towards the end of trade after closing at $0.1905 on Wednesday. Power utility Mosenergo MSNG.RTS fell to $1.244 from $1.264. Telecom Rostelekom RTKM.RTS declined to $3.76 from $3.83.
Pitaleff said sales by foreign investors overwhelmed domestic support which had been propping up the market over the last few days.
"Russian capital is unable to support or move the market now. I saw some interest in buying from the Russian side but not very big," he said.

Traders said the decline would continue tomorrow, Nikolai Fomintsev, head of trading at the East European Investment Company, said that short-covering could cause some prices to rise by Friday afternoon.
